defect_summary.title: Public Static Unauthenticated Domain Binding Seal Issuance

root_cause_details.vulnerability_mechanism: Method was defined as public static and accepted any CanonicalDomainBinding without requiring a secret authority key symbol or boot handshake token.
root_cause_details.token_entropy_flaw: generateSealToken used a plain SHA-256 hash over public string fields (SEAL:domain:entityId:revisionId:geometryHash) without an unexportable cryptographic HMAC secret.
root_cause_details.caller_impact: Any production or rogue component could instantiate an arbitrary payload, call sealBinding(binding), and produce an accepted authoritative binding.

affected_call_sites_audit.vulnerability: sealBinding was public static without key check
affected_call_sites_audit.remediation: Added mandatory authorityKey symbol parameter validated against SimulationAuthorityInternal

affected_call_sites_audit.vulnerability: Lacked HMAC secret key generation for binding seals
affected_call_sites_audit.remediation: Added boot HMAC secret generation and verifyAuthorityKey helper
Updated to pass getAuthorityBootKey() for unit test binding creation
Updated to pass getAuthorityBootKey() in production execution paths
Updated to pass getAuthorityBootKey() in iterative co-simulation loop
